infobox.usage: Unlocks the door to the ARRS station 14-4 KORD in the power station on Interchange.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Restored) (14-4 rst.) is a Keycard in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: This restored pass should now be able to unlock Station 14-4 KORD.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
- This item is not lootable from players and can only be placed in a special item slot.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the story chapter They Are Already Here

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the ARRS station 14-4 KORD in the basement of the power station on Interchange.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 5x PC block
- 1x Safe (locked) can be opened by pulling the lever after turning on power with the keypad on the wall, only containing the Mysterious audio tape when the story chapter They Are Already Here is active
- Loose loot (Electronics, Provisions)
- Intelligence folder spawns
